home.emptyBody: Add your bike, scooter, car or EV to start logging fill-ups and services.
home.allArchivedBody: Their data is kept. Restore one, or add a new vehicle.

history.emptyBody: Your fill-ups and services will appear here.

stats.emptyBody: Charts appear after a few full-tank fill-ups.

tools.emptyBody: Trip cost, mileage and fuel split calculators. No setup needed.

settings.currencyNote: Applies to new entries. Old entries keep their currency.
settings.devResetDescription: Dev builds only. Deletes all vehicles, fill-ups and settings, then restarts like a fresh install.

startup.errorBody: Please close the app completely and open it again.

onboarding.tagline: Real mileage, fuel cost and service reminders.
onboarding.privacy: No login. Your data stays on this phone.
onboarding.regionSubtitle: We picked this from your phone. It sets your currency, units and document names.
onboarding.regionLater: You can change any unit later in Settings.
onboarding.vehicleSubtitle: Just the basics. You can add more vehicles later.

vehicleForm.name: Name
vehicleForm.odometerHelp: The reading on your vehicle right now. Enter 0 if it's new.

errors.fuel_locked: This vehicle already has fill-ups in another unit. Add a new vehicle for this fuel.
errors.above_first_fill_up: Must be at or below your first fill-up's odometer

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.noActive: No active vehicles. Add one, or restore an archived one.

editVehicle.title: Edit vehicle
editVehicle.archiveNote: Sold it or not using it? Archive hides it from the switcher and keeps all its data.
editVehicle.archivedNote: This vehicle is archived. Restore it to log fill-ups again.
editVehicle.deleteBody: This deletes {{name}} and all its fill-ups, services and reminders. It can't be undone. To keep the data, archive it instead.
editVehicle.deleteTypeName: Type the vehicle name to confirm

fillUp.title: Add fill-up
fillUp.anyTwo: Enter any two. We calculate the third.
fillUp.fullTankHelp: Filled to the top. Mileage is worked out from one full tank to the next.
fillUp.fullChargeHelp: Charged to your usual full level. Mileage is worked out from one full charge to the next.
fillUp.missedHelp: Turn on if you forgot to log one. This tank's mileage is skipped so it's never wrong.

errors.DUPLICATE_ODOMETER: You already logged this odometer reading
errors.ODOMETER_BELOW_START: Must be at least {{limit}} (the vehicle's starting odometer)

fillUp.layout: How do you want to enter it?
fillUp.amountHint: Just what you paid. We work out the fuel from the price.
fillUp.amountHintEv: Just what you paid. We work out the energy from the price.
fillUp.warnHigh: That's unusually high mileage for this vehicle. Check the odometer and the fuel amount.
fillUp.warnLow: That's unusually low mileage for this vehicle. Check the odometer and the fuel amount.
fillUp.warnTank: That's more fuel than the tank holds ({{tank}}). Check the amount.
fillUp.deleteBody: Mileage for the tanks around it is worked out again. This can't be undone.

fillUpResult.title: Saved
fillUpResult.baselineBody: Your mileage shows after your next full tank.
fillUpResult.baselineEvBody: Your mileage shows after your next full charge.
fillUpResult.partialBody: It's included in your next full tank. Mileage shows then.
fillUpResult.partialEvBody: It's included in your next full charge. Mileage shows then.
fillUpResult.missedBody: A fill-up was missed before this, so this tank's mileage is skipped instead of being wrong. The next tanks show it again.

dashboard.start: Log your fill-ups here. Mileage shows after two full tanks.
dashboard.startEv: Log your charges here. Mileage shows after two full charges.
dashboard.needTwo: Mileage shows once you've logged two full tanks.
dashboard.needTwoEv: Mileage shows once you've logged two full charges.

errors.below_start: Can't be below the vehicle's starting odometer

more.toolsBody: Trip cost, mileage and fuel split

reminders.emptyBody: Services, insurance, emission test and licence renewals will show here.
reminders.doneRepeats: Marks it done today at your current odometer and sets the next one.
reminders.doneOnce: Marks it done today. It won't remind you again.

reminderForm.title: Add reminder
reminderForm.suggestion: Suggested interval. Check your owner's manual and change it if needed.
reminderForm.personLevel: Your licence belongs to you, not a vehicle, so it's due by date only.
reminderForm.dueHelp: Set a date, an odometer reading, or both.
reminderForm.deleteBody: It stops reminding you. This can't be undone.

errors.due: Set a date, an odometer reading, or both
